newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - 3Com raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - 3Com raised to buy.

text.p: -- First Albany Corp said it upgraded 3Com Corp to buy from neutral and set a $65 a share price target.
-- said the proposed stock-swap merger of 3Com and U.S. Robotics Corp "makes a much stronger company than either could be alone in so short a time."
-- said while there may be near-term integration problems, the proposed deal is a "very strategic and positive acquisition."
-- said the two companies have strong product synergies and world-class manufacturing capabilities.
-- said the companies will have to deal with some near-term issues such as integrated management, employees and addressing some small areas of product overlap.
-- said the deal may cause near-term dilution.
-- said in the worst case, the acquisition will be neutral to earnings for 1998.
-- said it is maintaining 3Com earnings estimates of $2.08 a share for 1997 and $2.70 a share in 1998. The estimates may be adjusted after more guidance from 3Com.
